  | season      = 1955–1956

The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1955–1956''' was contested by 36 teams participating in two divisions. The national champion was determined by a play-off featuring the two best placed teams in both divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Roda JC|Rapid JC]] won this year's championship by beating [[NAC Breda|NAC]], [[USV Elinkwijk|Elinkwijk]] and [[Sparta Rotterdam]].

==New entrant==
*[[ADO Den Haag|SHS]]
